sections.heading: Private health insurance rebate
sections.text:
The private health insurance rebate is a government contribution to help with the cost of your private health insurance.

Eligibility for the private health insurance rebate depends on your circumstances, including your policy and income.

How to claim the private health insurance rebate, how to claim for your spouse and if you have prepaid your premium.

LHC is a loading added to your hospital premium if you didn't have private hospital cover from the year you turn 31.

Find out the private health insurance rebate income thresholds and rebate percentage rates.

Your statement gives you information about your private health insurance premiums and private patient hospital cover.

Help for overseas visitors to complete the Medicare levy surcharge and private health insurance section on a tax return.
